name: Shubh Porwal
summary: Personal portfolio of product engineer Shubh Porwal, built with Next.js, GSAP, Tailwind CSS and React.
description: The personal portfolio of Shubh Porwal, a product engineer. Its MIT-licensed source, devfolio, is a Next.js site animated with GSAP and styled with Tailwind CSS and React; it is responsive and mobile-first, deployed on Vercel, and documented with a live demo plus forking instructions. The design may be drawn on as inspiration freely, while forked code should keep attribution.
